Bloons Tower Defense 6 is the newest release of the popular originally flash game series, Bloons Tower Defense
It removes some towers, such as the Bloonchipper from BTD5, and adds some new ones, such as the Druid and the hero towers
The hero towers are a new set of towers that only allow you to bring in one per game of BTD6, upgrade themselves on a single linear path, and can change how you play the game
For example, Benjamin allows for some easy early game income, and boosts late game income as well, by improving the banks
Quincy on the other hand, acts as camo detection, allowing you to save money early game
For example, you could get your first banana farm cheaper every game, making money easier to come by early game
One thing to note about the game
